image_description: A close-up view of a modern, curved staircase railing system. The primary feature is a thick, light-colored wooden handrail with a smooth finish, curving diagonally upwards. It is supported by a glass balustrade system held in place by metal clamps or standoffs attached to the steps and the handrail structure. In the background, perforated metal ceiling panels and lighting fixtures are visible.
